paper.title: Interactive Task and Concept Learning from Natural Language Instructions and GUI Demonstrations
paper.central_claim: Pumice：一种领域无关的多模态方法，先让用户用自然语言高层描述任务及条件，再与 agent 通过对话与 GUI 演示递归地解决含糊概念和新过程；用户也可通过引用/演示第三方手机 App 的 GUI 内容来定义新概念；10 人实验室研究显示其可用。

provenance.independence_note: Aggregation over two seat inputs; the fixed paper text was read in full before the seat scores, but this is not a third blind review or human gold. All results are author reports; nothing was reproduced.

preliminary_evidence_judgment: Read before seat scores. Pumice (AAAI-20 workshop version of the UIST-19 paper) is an end-user-programmable Android agent: a Sempre semantic parser emits a typed DSL with resolve() holes for unknown Boolean/value concepts and procedures; holes are resolved recursively by user explanation or GUI demonstration (Sugilite accessibility recording/replay, UI snapshot graph queries), stored in a persistent knowledge base and reused. Gap evidence: a 58-person MTurk formative study (33% vs 9% vague concepts with vs without app screenshots, p<0.05, kappa .87). System evidence: 10-user lab study, 4 author-designed tasks, 5-min tutorial, pre-taught concept, participants retried until correct execution; all completed; times with SD; Likert. No control, no ablation, no retry/error counts, no parser accuracy. Agent executes on real third-party apps; script correctness checked by experimenters under GPS-controlled conditions. Applicable: R02 (agent-initiated user interaction), C01.

scope_decision.reason: Final scope decision (edge): Pumice is an agent that perceives app GUIs through the Android accessibility tree and executes recorded/generalised procedures on real third-party apps; its contribution changes the instruction/clarification and knowledge part of the loop (concept grounding via GUI demonstration and agent-initiated questions). It is not pure API, UI-code generation or robotics, so it meets EVIDENCE.md scope. It is an edge case because evidence is an HCI usability study of human+agent authoring rather than autonomous task success; claim_type system_method is kept and E items are judged against that usability claim.

signatures.object: 由自然语言指令生成含条件与新概念的自动化脚本的“对话式概念解析”流程（相对基线：只能映射到预定义领域的 instructable agent）
signatures.information: 解析器无领域本体；用户口述与演示；系统读取演示 App 的完整 UI snapshot graph（含不可见对象，经 Accessibility API）。
signatures.operation: 语义解析把话语映射成类型化 DSL，未知的 Boolean/value/procedure 用 typed resolve() 占位；系统提问“How do I know whether X?”，用户用话语或 GUI 演示回答；递归直到全部解析；低置信度成分通过混合主动提问消歧；undo 回退。
signatures.output: 可执行的条件脚本 + 写入知识图的新过程/概念。
signatures.conditions: 用户熟悉相关 App；任务能通过现有手机 App 表达；单一基本布尔运算；前台执行。
signatures.feedback: 用户确认每个新概念/规则；用户 undo；解析置信度比较。
signatures.selection_rule: 用户确认=接受，undo/重述=拒绝；没有自动评分。
signatures.selection_data: 用户当场输入，无离线选择集。
signatures.persistence: 本机持久知识库：过程=Sugilite 脚本+参数+备选值；Boolean 概念=触发语+布尔表达式+上下文；value 概念=触发语+已演示的取值查询+上下文。
signatures.later_use: 后续任务命中同名概念时询问复用（三层复用），无需重复演示。
signatures.claimed_effect: 10 名参与者在教程后都完成 4 个任务(19.4–25 min)，Likert 易用 6.2/自然 6.1/有用 6.9。
signatures.failure_boundary: 语音识别错误、代词指代、单一布尔运算、Web App/游戏、仅前台、单用户、无语义理解(隐含参数)。

retained_trace.before: 无该概念/过程知识的解析器
retained_trace.proposed_change: 用户解释+演示得到的概念/过程
retained_trace.later_tasks: 用户研究 Task 1 复用预教概念(EV15)
retained_trace.measured_gain: 未测：无“有/无知识库”的对照

signatures.object: 把口头指代映射到第三方 App GUI 内容的 value 查询（演示式概念落地）
signatures.information: 演示时高亮与话语/比较常量类型兼容的 GUI 对象（如与 30 分钟比较的时长）；覆盖层可记录屏幕上所有数值，不限可点击元素。
signatures.operation: 用户长按选中目标值；系统把导航到该屏并取值的过程存为 value query，解析器把话语转为对 UI snapshot graph 的查询。
signatures.conditions: App 通过 Accessibility 暴露内容。
signatures.persistence: 存入知识库的 value query。
signatures.later_use: 之后任何需要该值的条件/概念。
signatures.claimed_effect: 形成性研究中 GUI 截图使含糊概念使用率 33%→9%（支持该设计动机）。
signatures.failure_boundary: Web App/特殊图形引擎；App 改版会令查询失效(文中提及仅“处理小改动”)。

gap.author_gap: 终端用户口头指令常含含糊/常识性概念（cold weather、heavy traffic）且常漏写 else；现有自然语言编程系统限定在预定义领域，PBD 系统多以演示为主、不学习可泛化的概念。
gap.checked_gap: 形成性研究给出可量化的前提证据：无 GUI 组 33% vs 有 GUI 组 9% 使用含糊概念(p<0.05，检验与组大小未给)；18% 漏 else、33% 漏可推断 else(EV02–EV04)。样本为 MTurk 58 人且排除 19%，效应量与检验细节不足，故“部分核实”。“唯一”声明(EV27)未经对比实验验证。

matches.reason: 实际操作是：把含糊处拆成类型化子问题，分派给用户话语/第三方 App GUI 查询这两个“求解者”，通过结构化中间物拼回脚本——与 decompose_and_delegate 的骨架相符。“求解者”是人和外部 App 而非形式化 solver，闭环无机器验证，因此 sub 卡 C25（要求机器可检验 artifact）不选，fit 记 partial。

rs_pattern.reason: 虽然这是 HCI/终端用户编程系统而非典型 ML 方法，仍能映射到 decompose_and_delegate 的操作骨架（类型化中间物 + 委托给外部求解来源）；匹配程度为 partial。

executes_pattern.note: 执行了分解+类型化占位+委托，但缺验证闭环与消融

resolves_problem.note: 可用性研究(n=10, 有教程, 作者设计任务)不足以证明含糊概念/else 遗漏问题被关闭；形成性研究只证明 GUI 落地能降低含糊使用率。

rs_pattern.aggregate_reason: Both seats choose decompose_and_delegate as the only match. Sub-card: C25's load-bearing element is closing the loop with a sound solver's machine-checkable output during construction; in Pumice the typed DSL is checkable but semantic resolution and verification come from the user (confirmation, undo), so no child is assigned (sub null), per PATTERN_PROTOCOL's allowance for an empty sub with stated difference.

domain_pattern.aggregate_note: R02 agreed. C01 (element-id actions over accessibility-tree objects) is a real operation of the agent (Sugilite/UI snapshot graph). gui:C19 is defined as knowledge from the agent's own runs; Pumice's knowledge is user-taught, which son55 itself rated weak, so it is not matched; the persistent user-taught knowledge base stays in unassigned.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: RS 的“分解并委托给外部求解来源”对应 Pumice 的“resolve() 占位 → 向用户提问 → 用户话语/GUI 演示作答”；R02 的“向用户发问并把回答写回历史”是同一交互的 GUI-agent 域对应物。
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: R02 要求 ask 决策被训练/度量；Pumice 的提问规则固定且不度量。委托对象是人而非形式化 solver，故 RS 子卡 C25 不成立。

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Weak online: the authored automations execute on real apps on a real phone and experimenters checked script correctness under controlled conditions (agg:P-A02); success is human+agent eventual completion, n=10, 4 designed tasks, no held-out apps, so not transfer.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported: after a 5-minute tutorial, 10 participants each eventually authored 4 author-designed conditional automations with new concepts on real Android apps (19.4-25 min total, high Likert ratings); a randomised formative study shows showing app GUIs reduces vague-concept use (33% -> 9%). Comparative benefit, concept-reuse accuracy, retry burden and untutored usability are not shown.
not_supported: Advantage over other tools or manual operation (no control)
Correctness/generalisation of learned concepts beyond the 4 tasks
Uniqueness claims versus prior PBD systems
assessment.retention_trace: Persistent knowledge base stores user-taught concepts/procedures for reuse; reuse is demonstrated in Task 1 (pre-taught 'hot') but not measured, so no retained-improvement claim is supported.

G.reason: Concrete bottleneck (vague concepts and omitted else in end-user instructions) measured by a randomised formative study; lineage (Sugilite/Appinite/Iris/LIA/PLOW/Sikuli) named with operational differences and residual limits stated. Not 4: neighbours author-attributed, 'only one' claims unverified, and the bottleneck sits in instruction specification rather than the perceive-act loop itself.

M.reason: Typed resolve() holes + recursive questions + GUI demonstration + persistent reuse map one-to-one onto the formative findings; reconstructable but no distinguishing ablation.

X.reason: Operation chain, information access (UI snapshot graph incl. invisible objects), knowledge-base schema, three reuse levels, undo and mixed-initiative disambiguation, and limits are described; DSL grammar and parser metrics absent in this version.

E.measurement.reason: Measures are eventual completion under unlimited retries, time and Likert, plus an unspecified experimenter script check; they fit 'usable' only coarsely and give no objective measure of concept correctness, errors or retries.

E.causality.reason: No comparator or feature ablation for the system; the randomised formative comparison motivates the design but does not attribute system effects.

E.holdout.reason: Tasks designed from the formative themes, parser trained mostly on formative data, same apps for teaching and testing, tutorial given; no held-out tasks or users.

E.statistics.reason: Denominator 10x4 and total-time SDs exist, but the retry-until-correct protocol hides the failure denominator, errors are qualitative only, Likert lacks dispersion, and the formative test is unnamed.

E.cost.reason: Authoring time reported and the teaching-cost concern discussed; no manual-operation or alternative-tool baseline, no parser latency.

score.formula: S=(15G+25M+20X+10Emeas+10Ecaus+10Ehold+5Estat+5Ecost)/4; unknown -> L uses 0, U uses 4; raw=null while any unknown

status_reason: Full fixed HTML text available and read (figure images are captions only); in scope per scope_decision; all eight items resolved.
aggregate_session_note: Configured model type fable (upstream claude-opus-5-5[1m]) per batch manifest model_types.opus55; no session id or invocation receipt is exposed to this agent.

resolutions.reason: C25 requires construction-time closure by a sound solver's machine-checkable output; Pumice's verification is user confirmation/undo, so sub null with the difference stated (sol's own check marks that condition partial).

C01 is executed (accessibility-tree element actions via Sugilite); gui:C19 requires knowledge distilled from the agent's own runs, whereas Pumice's is user-taught (son55 rated it weak and declined to claim execution).

As for 1802.08802, sol's 2 rests only on originals being outside the fixed pack. The paper supplies a measured, randomised formative study for the bottleneck, named lineage with differences, and stated residuals (anchor 3).

Completion is measured only after unlimited retries (agg:P-A01) with an unspecified script check and self-report; this is a coarse measure of the usability claim and none of concept correctness, so anchor 2 rather than sol's 3.

The sub-item covers statistics and failure denominators: the retry protocol hides failures, error counts are absent, Likert has no dispersion and the formative test is unnamed; n=10 with time SDs alone does not reach sol's 3.

No claim that a method improves an Android agent's task success relative to anything; the claim is authoring usability, judged under the E items. Named benchmarks/baselines postdate the paper and are not demanded (publication-time rule); the publication-time equivalent is judged.
No agent comparison on an online benchmark with run-to-run noise; the user study has no comparison arm.
No comparison of agent success under step caps.
The study runs on live third-party apps, so E20 applies (son55's not_applicable is wrong); device/OS stated and conditions controlled via GPS, but no evaluation date, app versions or drift handling.
No comparison of agents with different observation spaces; sol's 'met' records disclosure, but E21's premise is absent.
Layout robustness is an inherited Sugilite capability, not a Pumice claim (agg:P-A06); Pumice's generalisation claims concern concept reuse across task domains, judged under E.holdout.
